description: Use this when: the user asks about one public construction bid notice of 나라장터 (참가 조건, 면허, 지역, 등급, 공동도급, 기초금액, 낙찰하한율, 정정). Returns every recorded condition with the notice sentence it came from (모름 = not found in the notice), the check date, and the forecast block (예상 낙찰가, 예상 참가업체 수), masked for non-paying users. Do not use this when: the user asks whether their own company can enter (use check_eligibility).
name: get_notice
title: 공고 상세
